items.description: A complete monochrome landing page for an AI product. White panels sit on a hatched page, held together by thin corner brackets. In the hero is a generative ink sculpture: stippled loops caged around a glass sphere.

items.title: Ink Orbit Testimonials
items.description: The testimonials section from `ink-orbit-saas-template`, standalone and unchanged: a hatched page background, a bracketed frame holding a snap-scrolling row of quote cards (star rating, drawn quote marks, greyscale portrait), an arrows-and-dots pager, and a marquee of customer names, each with a gen

items.title: Iris Folio Template
items.description: A complete graphic-design portfolio drawn like a gouache cover. A swash **PORTFOLIO** wordmark in sky blue sits over a band of sunrise sky. Heart-shaped leaves spill past its edges, an art-nouveau vine frames a white iris, petals drift and sparkles glint. The cover carries your name in your own scri

items.title: Isoline Bloom
items.description: A living, lobed shape drawn only by its contour lines — neon hairlines flowing outward from an indigo core, violet on one side, magenta through the middle, ember red on the other. Move over it and the lines bulge around your pointer and the whole figure leans toward you; move fast and the rings pump

items.title: Isometric Lift Carousel
items.description: A minimal 3D photo carousel. Portrait photos stand on edge in a tilted row, seen from above and to the side like cards in a file box. The chosen photo widens and lifts out of the row on a spring. A small glass pill underneath holds prev, the dots and next.

items.title: Kamm Trek Landing
items.description: A complete landing page for a company that runs guided hut-to-hut treks, drawn as a Swiss topographic map that has come to life.

items.title: Keycap Orb
items.description: A ball of mechanical keycaps floating over a cobalt floor glow. Ink, ash, cobalt and lime caps in plastic, clear glass caps with the stem showing through, engraved legends, and the whole thing mirrored in the floor.

items.title: Kiln Wordmark Footer
items.description: A brick-red closing panel for a manufacturer with a sense of its own history. A two-line uppercase motto sits top left, a dark back-to-top key top right, then three columns (address, navigation, follow), a giant lowercase wordmark, and a legal bar in an outlined pill.

items.title: Lanyard Badge
items.description: An event badge hanging from a patterned lanyard. Two strands come down from above the frame, meet at a side-release buckle, and a short strap and ring hold the card. Drag the card and the strap pulls taut; flick it sideways and it spins on the ring; tap it, press Enter, or use the **Show back** butt

items.title: Lens Zoom Carousel
items.description: A full-bleed image carousel where the next picture lands like a fast zoom pull: out of a soft, magnified blur with two fading ghost copies trailing it, while the old picture falls back. Going back zooms out instead of in.

items.title: Lilac Dusk Canopy
items.description: [Dappled Canopy](../dappled-canopy/README.md) set to its `lilac-dusk` preset by default: dusk light on a violet wall: coral sun, plum shadows. Same shader, props and interaction. Move across it to push the leaves, click for a gust. Every other preset still works through `preset`.

items.title: Lilac Meadow Landing
items.description: A complete landing-page template for a yield-bearing stablecoin, in a soft "money grows" art direction: chrome coins half buried in a meadow of tiny lilac flowers under a pale lavender sky. The page continues in the same hand: a "what is it" statement, three feature cards (a coneflower growing besid

items.title: Long Exposure Agency Template
items.description: A complete automation-agency site in one component, full screen and edge to edge: a pale page with a quiet serif, ink buttons and soft grey cards. Every picture is a long-exposure blur of a landscape that was never photographed, drawn live in WebGL.

items.title: Longhand Notes Landing
items.description: A complete landing page for a handwritten-notes service, where robots write your cards with real pens. It is drawn in one line-art language: ribbed tubes, coral motor housings, teal joints and coral dashed flight paths, on grey paper and white card.

items.title: Löyly Sauna Landing
items.description: A complete landing page for a public sauna and cold plunge, printed in two inks. A cool white grid sheet, one Swiss grotesk and a halftone screen in safety orange and black: **orange is heat, black is cold**. *Löyly* is the Finnish word for the steam that rises when water hits hot stones.

items.title: Lunar Boarding Pass
items.description: A two-sided ticket to the Moon: a black **VIP pass** on the front, a silver **boarding pass** with a perforated stub on the back.

items.title: Lycoris Specimen
items.description: A scroll-scrubbed type specimen built around one object: a red chrome spider lily, modelled procedurally and lit in raw WebGL. Six frames, one continuous camera move:

items.title: Magic Hour
items.description: A scroll-scrubbed video. Scroll owns the timeline — nothing autoplays. items.title: Maroon Fintech Landing
items.description: A complete finance-SaaS landing page in one component. A maroon frame holds a cream hero where a sage-green device sits at the centre of a circuit board, with live expense and income cards at its feet. items.description: A full-bleed portfolio poster: a one-point-perspective grid room, a stacked display headline (`2026 ↘ UI / PORTFOLIO / DESIGN / WORK(S)*`) with a looping swash, a vertical tag and bracket arcs, a split "Seeking / UI · Graphic" pill, a doodled flower and arrow, a services row — and a 3D-style mascot

items.title: Meridian Mist
items.description: A grainy cobalt mesh gradient under a drafting overlay: sky blue catching the top-left corner, a royal bloom in the middle, navy pooling into the bottom-left and slate grey everywhere the light doesn't reach. On top sit hairline guides (two columns, a few rows, and a pair of large overlapping circle

items.title: Mono Contrast Preloader
items.description: A crushed black-and-white luminance grade at 2.2x contrast, over soft archival footage whose 480p grain the treatment reads as film rather than as a defect.

items.title: Morph Gallery
items.description: A photo gallery whose slides dissolve into each other through noise instead of cutting or cross-fading. Arrows, thumbnails, keyboard, swipe and autoplay.

items.title: Murmuration Wordmark
items.description: Thousands of starlings over a dusk sky. The flock rolls and folds the way a real murmuration does, in thin ribbons and dense dark knots, driven by a slow curl-noise current and a wandering centre of gravity. Every few seconds it converges, bird by bird, into your word, holds it, and scatters again.

items.title: Neon Katakana Preloader
items.description: A cyberpunk title-card loading gate. The word is **ウィンドウ** ("window"), and the gate opens like one.

items.title: Noise Dissolve Reveal
items.description: A sheet of colour covering your content, which dissolves along a fractal-noise threshold. Holes nucleate, spread into ragged islands, and merge until the page underneath is bare. The edges are fibrous rather than clean, so it reads as paper tearing or ink bleeding, not as a wipe or a fade.

items.title: Odometer Stage Stats
items.description: A "by the numbers" section that puts one figure on stage at a time: a committed colour field, one enormous condensed numeral in the middle, the line that explains it underneath, a short story pinned to alternating corners, and the stat's key word set huge and faint along the bottom edge.

items.title: Onward Summit Template
items.description: A complete one-day event page in one component. The hero runs from navy down to white and is filled with tiny arrows that lean away from the pointer, ripple out from a click and shimmer on their own, clearing a space around the event's name. Below it, on white, come seven sections: what to expect, a

items.title: Onyx Glyph Preloader
items.description: A cinematic loading gate in sandblasted black metal.

items.title: Open Slot Booking
items.description: A "book a call" section that does the booking itself. A heavy two-tone headline sits over a quiet scheduler window on a tilted colour slab. items.title: Paper Curl Carousel
items.description: An image carousel where every slide is a printed sheet. Drag its edge, click, or press an arrow and the sheet rolls over a cylinder, shows the paper stock on its back, and lays a shadow across the sheet underneath.

items.title: Particle Dissolve Carousel
items.description: An image carousel made of dust. Change slides and the picture comes apart: a wave crosses it, every grain lifts off carrying its own colour, rides a drifting flow field, then turns and settles back into place as a grain of the next picture. At rest the picture keeps shedding a little dust, and a fli

items.title: Perforated Stripe Curtain
items.description: A curtain of punched-tape strips hung in front of a picture. Idle, the strips hang grey and ragged over a dimmed image, with a play button. items.description: A full-screen "page not found" on a pink-phosphor tube. items.title: Pigment Experience Ledger
items.description: An "Experience" section for a portfolio, résumé or about page. Each employer is a huge right-aligned wordmark with its years in italics on the left. items.title: Pinboard Portfolio Hero
items.description: A full-bleed portfolio hero drawn as a lit studio wall: a stamped `PORT` / `FOLIO` lockup with the lower line mirrored on its baseline, two cut-out portraits breaking out of the letters, hand-lettered service labels, and pinned paper joined by red floss.

items.title: Pixel Park Template
items.description: A complete one-page site for a small New York company, told in pixel art. A moonlit park meadow sits under a floating glass nav, with the company name and a frosted mission card over it. Below that come a manifesto, a signed letter with a postage stamp, a careers card over a skyline and lake, contac

items.title: Plumb Payroll Template
items.description: A complete construction-payroll landing page in one component, laid out on a drafting grid: hairline rails run down the page, dashed guides run out past them, and every block is boxed in by its own rules.

items.title: Pocket Portfolio
items.description: A minimal, card-stacked one-page portfolio template. White rounded cards on a soft grey page, a pill nav, one hot accent colour.

items.title: Polaroid Line Carousel
items.description: Instant photos pegged to a sagging string. Drag the line and the prints slide along it, swinging on their pegs with the speed you give them and settling back; at rest they sway in a light breeze. Click a print to bring it to the middle. Page colours follow the theme tokens.

items.title: Polaroid Zine Hero
items.description: An editorial zine page as a hero: a cream sheet with a taped typewritten slip, a centre print whose subject is cut out of its own frame, five pinned snapshots, a handwritten line running over the print, and a justified typewriter column. The page dots and the edge arrow are real carousel controls, n

items.title: Postmark CTA
items.description: The closing call to action of a landing page: the last block before the footer. A heavy two-line headline, one primary button and a quiet secondary link sit on a halftone field, with a loose collection of postage stamps scattered around them.

items.title: Prism Comet Preloader
items.description: A cinematic loading gate built like a motion designer's effects stack, with the load progress as the interpolation slider. Every frame is one WebGL shader, and each stage is the same light bent into a new shape. Nothing cross-fades between pictures.

items.title: Quiet Portfolio Template
items.description: A complete, minimal personal site in one component: calm type, generous whitespace, one accent colour, and a lot of small interactions that only show up when you reach for them.

items.title: Raked Sand Garden
items.description: A full-bleed karesansui gravel bed seen from above under a low sun. The gravel is a real heightfield. items.title: Rangoli Preloader
items.description: A loading screen drawn in coloured powder on a red-oxide floor. items.title: RGB Glitch Carousel
items.description: A full-bleed image carousel that cuts between pictures with a signal glitch: for a split second the picture tears into horizontal bands and its red, green and blue channels slide apart, then it snaps back as the next picture. Canvas 2D, no WebGL.

items.title: Scanline Bloom
items.description: A bouquet of lilies and roses printed in red on black paper, the way a cheap risograph or a dying CRT would do it: ragged horizontal scanlines that thicken with the light, a stipple dither that takes over toward the bottom, paper grain, and a thin frame behind it all.

items.title: Seam History Timeline
items.description: The "Our story" section of an about page: a company's milestones as wide photo cards running off the right edge of the section. items.title: Shutter Blinds Carousel
items.description: A full-bleed image carousel where the next picture swings in on horizontal slats, like blinds tilting open one after another, while the old picture dims behind them. Forward runs the slats top to bottom, back runs them bottom to top.

items.title: Shutter Glyph Footer
items.description: A signal-orange closing section set in monospace caps, with the brand drawn across the full width in a geometric display alphabet. One letter is swapped for a **shutter**: three black blades that meet at a pivot, and the pivot turns to follow the pointer.

items.title: Sidebar Portfolio Template
items.description: A complete one-page portfolio in a single file. It's quiet and minimal: warm paper, serif headings, one accent colour. A profile sidebar sticks on the left, and the reading column holds everything else:

items.title: Silhouette Wrap
items.description: A paragraph that parts around a falling silhouette, follows its **actual outline** — a keyhole's waist, a bottle's neck — and closes back up underneath. Scroll and the shape drops through the column; every line is set again.

items.title: Singularity Horizon
items.description: A black hole with a live accretion disk, cycling through named states — nominal, turbulent, collapsing — with a relativistic HUD over it. Drag to orbit.

items.title: Slat Count Preloader
items.description: A Swiss-poster loading gate built out of black slats on vermilion.

items.title: Slit Type FAQ
items.description: A frequently-asked-questions section set in one ink on one paper. The display headline is cut by a hard horizontal slit: its capitals rise into the slit as the section scrolls in and rest there, cut through, like a stencil pulled before the print is finished. Hovering the headline lifts the letters

items.title: Spotlight Offer Quiz
items.description: The discount popup that asks one good question first. A spotlit studio stage on the right, a huge offer, one personal question and a stack of answer pills. items.title: Staircase Carousel
items.description: A minimal photo carousel laid out as a staircase. The chosen photo sits level at full size, with its title beside it. items.title: Starburst Thanks Footer
items.description: A "thank you for your time" sign-off for the end of a portfolio, case study or deck. It has heavy extended caps, a hand-lettered line underneath, a loose pen loop around both, and a hot-pink starburst. Contact pills sit at the bottom, with little pointing hands under the links. The background is dar

items.title: Stardust Stage Preloader
items.description: A cinematic loading gate in black-and-white stipple. A lone star in a pixel-art cosmos turns into a moonlit theatre stage, and every dot on screen moves in that change.

items.title: Stencil Labs Template
items.description: A complete studio / incubator site on one hairline grid. The page is cool grey paper with monospace text, orange chamfered buttons, and display type in a stencil face that is drawn in the file. Empty spacer rows between sections let the column rules run through the page.

items.title: Stepped Morph Slider
items.description: An image slider whose window is a stepped, skyline-like mask. Each slide has its own blocky shape; moving to the next one morphs the mask column by column — a left-to-right stagger — while the picture cross-fades and drifts. Hover lifts the column under the pointer.

items.title: Sticker Hello Portfolio
items.description: A whole designer portfolio template with a sense of humour. A huge condensed serif says *"Hi, I'm Juniper."*, and two sticker puns are slapped on it. The rest is a stack of case studies, a sticker sheet to play with, an about page and a footer that wants to hear from you.

items.title: Sunlit Cutting Mat
items.description: An animated WebGL background: a green self-healing cutting mat on a desk by a window. Sunlight falls across it through a slatted blind and past foliage outside: soft, straight diagonal bands broken up by blurred leaf shadows, drifting slowly. The light is blocked, not refracted, so nothing ripples.

items.title: Ticket Stub Footer
items.description: A dark, hairline-ruled closing section for an ops product, with the brand printed on an orange ticket.

items.title: Tiger Tear Reveal
items.description: A scroll-driven poster hero. The page starts as a plain slogan: a small tagline over one huge red word. items.description: A scrollbar built out of tiles on a tilted tray. items.description: A minimal photo carousel. Square photos sit on a slanted line. The one in front is upright at full size. items.description: A loading gate for a designer's portfolio. While the page loads, one word (`PORTFOLIO` by default) is re-typeset through seven cover treatments, each wiping over the last as the count climbs:

items.title: Velocity Reel
items.description: A scroll-scrubbed cinematic title sequence. Ten shots on one canvas: a rim-lit face, an archer drawing, an arrow through glass, a blade through what is left of it, a fly-through of the shards, then a jet, a supercar and a formula car tearing out of the debris on red light, a burst, and an emblem.

items.title: Velvet Haze
items.description: An out-of-focus light leak on grainy black film: a silver haze high on the left, violet bleeding in at the top right, a warm ember between them, and two shadows cutting it — a silk fold that sweeps the light off the bottom of the frame and a dark mass curling in from the right. items.description: A minimal photo carousel built around a viewfinder frame. Only the photo in the frame lies flat. items.description: A loading gate for a portfolio, printed like a record sleeve in two inks. A giant record sits on the left with your name on its label, and a halftone starburst throbs on the right in time with the tempo. While the page loads:

items.title: Water Ripple Carousel
items.description: A full-bleed image carousel where tapping drops a ripple: a ring of bending water spreads from the tap, refracting the old picture at its edge, with the next picture inside it. One WebGL fragment shader. Off-origin images need CORS; without WebGL (or CORS) it simply cuts.

items.title: Waving Portfolio Landing
items.description: A red-on-paper poster landing page with a cinematic intro. The poster reads as two rows of tall condensed capitals sharing one giant letter: **P [O] RT / F [O] LIO**, with an ink-drawn character leaning out of the gap.

items.title: Weight Sweep Preloader
items.description: A type-specimen loading gate. The whole page is one giant counter set in a variable grotesk, and as the load climbs from `000` to `100` the numerals thicken from hairline to black. items.title: Wirebound Inquiry
items.description: A contact section for a studio, agency or freelancer, built as a wire-bound notebook. Closed, the kraft cover is already a contact card: your name printed big, a highlighter band that opens the brief, your email and socials written on the cover lines. Open it and the project inquiry is one question

items.title: Wordmark Newsletter Signup
items.description: A newsletter signup for a brand that is loud about its name. items.title: Zero Melt Preloader
items.description: A page gate with no enter button. A sheet of ice wipes down over the surface while a counter runs to zero, then you **melt your way in by tracing a circle**. Get the shape right and the screen blows out to white, pays you, and lifts.
